ImageDescription.value: QUEBEC CITY (July 22, 2026) – U.S. Navy Sailors assigned to Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS Mahan (DDG 72) stand security watch as the ship transits the St. Lawrence River before Rendez-vous naval de Québec, July 22, 2026. Mahan is participating in Rendez-vous naval de Québec, an international maritime festival aimed at strengthening naval partnerships, promoting interoperability and celebrating the shared maritime heritage of allied nations. (U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 2nd Class Oscar Pichardo)
